checks: Only explicitly registered animated assets receive playback controllers; static images are rejected.
Opening detail pauses background animation but allows an explicitly started detail preview.
Offscreen and page-hidden pause reasons compose; removing one reason does not clear the other.
User pause and reduced-motion require an explicit restart and remain independent of detail-open state.
At most one scene/gallery animation runs at a time while a detail animation can play separately.
Playback rejection returns to its poster and reports an error.
A pending play completion cannot overwrite pause state; it restarts only after all pause reasons clear.
The production catalog remains static and controller teardown removes browser listeners.
